SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control) AS treated, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted) AS conversions, COALESCE(SUM(io.revenue_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.retained) AS defended FROM retention_intervention ri
JOIN intervention_outcome io ON io.intervention_id = ri.intervention_id

SELECT ri.action_type AS actionType, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control), 0), 1) AS treatPct, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ri.is_control AND io.converted) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ri.is_control), 0), 1) AS controlPct, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted) AS conv, COALESCE(SUM(io.revenue_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control) AS treatN, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ri.is_control) AS controlN, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ri.is_control AND io.converted) AS controlConv FROM retention_intervention ri
JOIN intervention_outcome io ON io.intervention_id = ri.intervention_id
GROUP BY ri.action_type ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT ri.risk_type AS riskType, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control), 0), 1) AS treatPct, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ri.is_control AND io.converted) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ri.is_control), 0), 1) AS controlPct, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control) AS treated, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted) AS treatConv, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ri.is_control) AS controlN, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ri.is_control AND io.converted) AS controlConv FROM retention_intervention ri
JOIN intervention_outcome io ON io.intervention_id = ri.intervention_id
GROUP BY ri.risk_type ORDER BY treated DESC

SELECT ri.created_at::date AS day, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control) AS sent, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted) AS converted FROM retention_intervention ri
JOIN intervention_outcome io ON io.intervention_id = ri.intervention_id WHERE ri.created_at >= COALESCE(CAST(#{from} AS timestamp), NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')
AND ri.created_at < (CAST(#{to} AS date) + INTERVAL '1 day')
GROUP BY ri.created_at::date ORDER BY day

SELECT c.name, c.discount_type AS discountType, c.discount_value AS discountValue, COUNT(uc.user_coupon_id) AS issued, COUNT(uc.user_coupon_id) FILTER (WHERE uc.used) AS used, CASE WHEN c.discount_type = 'AMOUNT' THEN COUNT(uc.user_coupon_id) FILTER (WHERE uc.used) * c.discount_value ELSE ROUND(COUNT(uc.user_coupon_id) FILTER (WHERE uc.used) * c.discount_value / 100.0 * (SELECT COALESCE(AVG(total_price), 0) FROM orders WHERE payment_status = 'PAID')) END AS estimatedCost FROM coupons c LEFT JOIN user_coupons uc ON uc.coupon_id = c.coupon_id WHERE c.coupon_id IN (3, 4, 5, 6, 8) GROUP BY c.coupon_id, c.name, c.discount_type, c.discount_value ORDER BY issued DESC
